verses.text: Allegedly, some early-17th-century prints of the King James Version had this verse as “…he went into the city,” while some others had it as “…she went into the city,” though I have not seen enough of the early KJV prints to confirm this. The 1609 Douay Old Testament has it as “…vpon her. Who carying it entred into the citie, and came to her mother in law.”
